sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 6a)

purpose.zh: 不用器械练手腕前侧的力量，撑地时手腕更扛得住
purpose.en: Builds wrist strength with no gear, so your wrists can take more weight.

text.zh: 掌心朝上，另一只手压住掌心给阻力
text.en: Palm up, your other hand presses on it

text.zh: 被压的手往上卷，上面的手往下顶，慢慢走完全程。
text.en: Curl the bottom hand up while the top hand presses down, all the way.

text.zh: 前臂一直贴着大腿，只有手腕在动。
text.en: Your forearm stays on your thigh, only the wrist moves.

commonErrors.zh: 前臂抬起来、肩膀帮忙使劲
commonErrors.en: Lifting the forearm or using your shoulder.

commonErrors.zh: 上面的手压太狠，动作变形
commonErrors.en: Pressing so hard the movement falls apart.

cautions.zh: 留两三下余力，手腕疼就停
cautions.en: Leave two or three reps in the tank, stop if your wrist hurts.

thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 2–3 组 × 每侧 8–12 次，留 2–3 次余力
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
